chapter_title_en: Sacred Sacrifice and the Path of the War Ancestor

chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen's holy sacrifice reaches its peak, but he cannot become an Ancestral God. He accepts the War Ancestor path, creates a sleeper agent, and plans a return to the Nine Provinces.
og_title: Holy Sacrifice: Xiao Chen Forges the War Ancestor Body
og_description: After burning an Ancestral God's essence, Xiao Chen realizes he can never be a true god. He embraces the path of the War Ancestor, plants a spy in the Otherworld, and prepares to rescue the captured cultivators.
